title: Bangkok Open 2026 Results: Genesis Ouano Beats Wu Kun Lin 13-12
description: Genesis Ouano won the 2026 Universal Bangkok Open, beating Wu Kun Lin 13-12 in the final. Full final and semi-final results, prize fund and what's next.
body:
Genesis Ouano is the 2026 Universal Bangkok Open champion. In a final that went the full distance, he beat Wu Kun Lin 13-12 on Saturday, November 21, at S1 Pool Hall & Sport Bar in Bangkok, Thailand.

Bangkok Open 2026: final and semi-final results

  • Final (race to 13): Genesis Ouano 13-12 Wu Kun Lin
  • Semi-final: Wu Kun Lin 11-8 Andri Januarta
  • Semi-final: Genesis Ouano 11-10 Jaycee Cordova Garcia

Both of Ouano's last two matches went hill-hill: 11-10 in the semi-final and 13-12 in the final. The event ran November 17-21 with a $63,000 prize fund and was a World Nineball Tour ranking event.

How the bracket opened up

Several big names went out before the final weekend, which is what our video above breaks down. Andri Januarta reached the semi-finals after an 11-10 quarter-final win over Nalaunan before losing 11-8 to Wu Kun Lin. Our quarter-final recap Short covers that match (archive footage, not from Bangkok; footage: The Sharkstream, CC BY).

What's next in pro pool

The big one is next: the Mosconi Cup 2026, USA vs Europe, November 27-30 in Orlando, live in the US on ESPN+ and WNT TV. After that come the Mezz Sevilla Open (December 5-7) and more. See our pro pool calendar for dates and where to watch every event.
